dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin hits $60B market cap as retail demand surges, with analysts eyeing potential highs around $0.50 and beyond amid #bullish momentum despite overbought signals.

https://t.co/atjlgn2o3i

#Bitcoin, #XRP, and #Dogecoin prices fell after President #Trump's administration confirmed imminent tariffs on China, Mexico, and Canada. Bitcoin dipped below $101,600, reflecting market sensitivity to geopolitical tensions.

https://t.co/g75J6yJHpM

#Dogecoin has formed a rare "death cross" against #Bitcoin, where its 23-day moving average falls below the 200-day moving average, signaling potential bearish trends. This pattern suggests #DOGE may underperform #BTC, raising concerns for #crypto
